mapper.insert: insert into ai_model_config ( model_name, model_type, api_key, base_url, enabled, tool_enabled, created_at, updated_at ) values ( #{modelName}, #{modelType}, #{apiKey}, #{baseUrl}, #{enabled}, #{toolEnabled}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} )
mapper.update: update ai_model_config set model_name = #{modelName}, model_type = #{modelType}, api_key = #{apiKey}, base_url = #{baseUrl}, enabled = #{enabled}, tool_enabled = #{toolEnabled}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select id, model_name, model_type, api_key, base_url, enabled, tool_enabled, created_at, updated_at from ai_model_config where id = #{id}
select id, model_name, model_type, api_key, base_url, enabled, tool_enabled, created_at, updated_at from ai_model_config where model_name = #{modelName}
select id, model_name, model_type, api_key, base_url, enabled, tool_enabled, created_at, updated_at from ai_model_config where enabled = #{enabled}
select id, model_name, model_type, api_key, base_url, enabled, tool_enabled, created_at, updated_at from ai_model_config where enabled = true
